article_title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes

tasks.prompt: What two areas does the fact-finding mission's report examine?
options: US strikes on civilian sites and Iranian repression of protests
Only negotiations over nuclear weapons
Only the conduct of Iranian protesters
US domestic law and British military policy
tasks.correct_answer: US strikes on civilian sites and Iranian repression of protests
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדו״ח עוסק בתקיפות במינאב ולמרד ובדיכוי המחאות באיראן.

tasks.prompt: Which evidence did the experts cite when attributing the Minab strike to the US?
options: Iran's refusal to comment alone
Reports of a preliminary US inquiry and US possession of Tomahawk missiles
A final publicly released US investigation
A statement admitting deliberate civilian targeting
tasks.correct_answer: Reports of a preliminary US inquiry and US possession of Tomahawk missiles
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המומחים הסתמכו על דיווחים על בדיקה ראשונית ועל זהות המחזיק בטילי טומהוק; ממצאי הבדיקה האמריקאית טרם פורסמו.

tasks.prompt: What does “reasonable grounds to believe” communicate about the mission's findings?
options: A claim without any supporting evidence
A final judicial conviction
An evidence-based conclusion expressed with a qualified standard of certainty
An admission by the accused government
tasks.correct_answer: An evidence-based conclusion expressed with a qualified standard of certainty
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הניסוח מציין בסיס ראייתי למסקנה מסויגת, ולא הרשעה בבית משפט.

tasks.prompt: What distinction is made when experts reject “collateral damage” as the explanation for the school strike?
options: They say no school was damaged
They say the school was a military base
They say the damage was caused by protesters
They say the school itself was the intended impact point rather than incidentally damaged
tasks.correct_answer: They say the school itself was the intended impact point rather than incidentally damaged
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי מסקנת המומחים, בית הספר היה נקודת הפגיעה המיועדת ולא נפגע כתוצאה נלווית מתקיפת המתחם הסמוך.

tasks.prompt: How did the US military respond to the Lamerd allegations?
options: It denied conducting strikes there that day and disputed the weapon identification
It released a final report accepting responsibility
It said the sports complex was destroyed in January protests
It confirmed using Tomahawk missiles there
tasks.correct_answer: It denied conducting strikes there that day and disputed the weapon identification
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הצבא האמריקאי הכחיש תקיפות בלמרד באותו יום וחלק על זיהוי הנשק כ־PrSM.

tasks.prompt: What does “expedited trials” mean in the discussion of executions?
options: Trials postponed indefinitely
Trials conducted on an accelerated timetable
Trials conducted only outside Iran
Trials with charges withdrawn
tasks.correct_answer: Trials conducted on an accelerated timetable
tasks.explanation_hebrew: expedited פירושו מזורז; הכתבה מתארת הוצאות להורג לאחר משפטים מזורזים.

tasks.prompt: Why should a summary distinguish the official protest death toll from Hrana's figure?
expected_points: The mission could not independently verify the total
Hrana says it confirmed more than 7,000 deaths
The figures come from different sources and describe victims differently
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשמור על ייחוס המקורות ועל אי־הוודאות ולא להציג מספר אחד כמוסכם.

tasks.prompt: According to the experts, how did attacks on healthcare facilities worsen harm during the crackdown?
expected_points: Wounded demonstrators were beaten and arrested
Victims were deterred from seeking life-saving treatment
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לייחס את התיאור למומחים ולהסביר כיצד הפעולות הרתיעו פנייה לטיפול.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the mission's findings on the two February strikes, including the US responses.
expected_points: The experts examined Minab school and Lamerd sports complex
They found grounds to attribute both strikes to the US
They classified the attacks as indiscriminate war crimes
The US investigation into Minab remains unpublished
The US denied the Lamerd strike and rejected the report's credibility
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית תוך ייחוס המסקנות למומחים והצגת ההכחשות והבדיקה שטרם פורסמה.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the report presents civilians as facing danger from both conflict and domestic repression. Use evidence from each part and preserve attribution.
expected_points: Experts describe civilian deaths in Minab and Lamerd
They report lethal force and extensive arrests during protests
They report torture and denial of legal counsel
They conclude Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity
Both US and Iranian responses should be distinguished from expert findings
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב הסבר באנגלית עם ראיה מכל חלק, להבחין בין ממצאים, דיווחים ותגובות, ללא טענות שאינן בכתבה.
